text:
carla: Heads-up  a couple APAC folks said the orientation invite shows the wrong local time. Can we make the event explicit?

ethan: Looks like the event was created in UTC. We're running at 10:00 PT tomorrow (America/Los_Angeles). I'll update if someone doesn't beat me to it.

anya: I'll edit now: set event TZ to America/Los_Angeles, attach fresh ICS, and paste an explicit ISO start time in the description.

carla: Can we also paste the raw join URL + passcode and a fallback link? Mobile/calendar clients sometimes strip query params.

anya: Added this snippet into the event body and pinned it:```
Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/3216549870?pwd=onboard
Passcode: Welcome!2026
Fallback: https://zoom.us/w/3216549870
Start (PT): 2026-10-05T10:00:00-07:00
```

ethan: Nice. Can onboarding-bot confirm recording location and retention? Some hires will watch later.

onboarding-bot: Recording will be uploaded to s3://redwood-onboarding/recordings. A share link will be posted in #new-hires within 30 minutes after the session. Retention: 90 days.

carla: I'll DM the APAC new hires with the PT time and a note to "Add to calendar" manually if their client auto-accepts.

anya: Also added a one-line host instruction: "Put raw join URL on first slide and in chat."

ethan: Thanks all. If anyone still sees funky times after the change, reply here and we'll send one-off invites. :thumbsup:
